purpose: Replace the SD 1.5-only assumption after the character LoRA held-out result failed, while keeping the same full-body identity-only dataset and held-out contract.

dataset.train: 19 approved full-body character reference views; no scene images, face crops, or hand-detail images
dataset.preprocessing: source PNG only; aspect-ratio-preserving resize with white padding; no crop

caption_correction.failure: the previous caption silently truncated bag-strap, style, and view information

animagine_xl_4.quality: failed: three held-out scenes lost the character entirely; the remaining image did not satisfy the clothing, bag, action, or camera contract
animagine_xl_4.assets: PNG and adapter pruned after review

sdxl_base_1_0.quality: identity and style partial pass: teal bob, white jacket, teal trousers, white sneakers, and a navy bag recur more consistently than with SD 1.5 or Animagine XL. Face, hair clip, bag geometry, target action, and low-angle camera remain failures.
sdxl_base_1_0.next_gate: Do not run StoryDiffusion or inpaint. Test exactly one structural condition against this SDXL base LoRA before expanding the pipeline.
